entities.name: Setha
entities.description: Khenra initiate of Tah crop from Naktamun, brother of Basetha; killed in the Trial of Ambition.

entities.name: Basetha
entities.description: Khenra initiate of Tah crop, sister of Setha, who survived the Trial of Ambition, was killed in the Trial of Zeal and re-killed by Samut as part of the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: The last survivor of Tah crop.

entities.name: Neit
entities.description: A Tah crop initiate who cut out another initiate's heart and was later killed.

entities.name: Nassor
entities.description: A Tah crop initiate who survived the Trial of Ambition and was later killed.

entities.name: Tah crop
entities.description: The crop of initiates to which Setha and Basetha belonged.

entities.name: Trial of Ambition
entities.description: A trial in which Setha was killed by swirling blades.

entities.name: Trial of Zeal
entities.description: A trial in which Basetha, Neit and Nassor died.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: The horde on Ravnica Basetha later joined.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city the twins came from.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Basetha was re-killed.

events.summary: Setha is killed by swirling blades in the Trial of Ambition.
events.quote: Setha was killed by swirling blades in the Trial

events.summary: Basetha survives the Trial of Ambition by stealing the heart Neit had cut out of another initiate.
events.quote: She completed the trial by stealing the heart

events.summary: Basetha, Neit and Nassor die in the Trial of Zeal, leaving Djeru the last survivor of Tah crop.
events.quote: leaving Djeru as the last survivor of Tah crop

events.summary: Basetha joins the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and is re-killed by Samut.

relations.note: Setha was the brother and Basetha the sister.
relations.quote: Setha was the brother, and Basetha was the sister

relations.note: Basetha became part of the Dreadhorde.
relations.quote: Basetha later became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica
